name.value: Tyee Pier fuel dock and convenience store

description.value: Tyee Pier fuel dock and convenience store is a marine fuel and retail stop operated by Port Alberni Marine Fuels and Services Ltd., situated on a pier in the Port Alberni area of Vancouver Island. The facility primarily serves recreational and commercial boaters but, as a waterfront convenience store, could offer a useful supply stop for touring cyclists passing through the region. Its pier setting and marine focus make it an unusual entry point for land-based travellers.
